**CONTINENTAL WORKS**

**Parts — End-to-End Flow**

Development Team Reference · Master Flow, Sub-Flows & State Machines

| Audience | Engineering — build reference for the Parts module |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Version** | v1.0 · Implementation-neutral (no stack assumptions) |
| **Relationship** | Companion to the Parts Division SOW \+ SRS (FR-PRT series). The SOW says WHAT; this document says WHAT HAPPENS, IN WHAT ORDER, BY WHOM, and WHICH STATES CHANGE. |
| **Structure** | §1 Actors · §2 Master Flow · §3–6 Sub-Flows (Estimation, Procurement, Requisition & Custody, Returns) · §7 State Machines & Transition Tables · §8 Notifications · §9 Build Order |

**Hard rules baked into this flow (do not soften in implementation):** (1) estimate prices LOCK at submission — no post-submission price edits; unavailability is handled by substitution as a NEW line requiring new approval. (2) Foreign-sourced parts have a HARD GATE — no PO is created until the customer's 100% advance is confirmed received. (3) Every physical hand-off captures signature and/or photo proof. (4) Partial fulfillment is allowed — ready lines never wait for missing ones. (5) GRN is performed by the store keeper alone. (6) Requisitions are auto-approved by customer approval of the estimate lines — there is no second human approval step.

# **Contents**

# **1\. Actors & Responsibilities**

| Actor | Module | Responsibility in this flow |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Service Engineer (SE) | Execution | Raises parts requirement at diagnosis (description \+ media, no part number). Can also be the floor Receiver. |
| Parts Buyer / Estimator | Parts | Resolves description → Part Number, prices from vendor matrix, builds/submits estimates, raises POs. |
| Service Advisor (SA) | Customer-facing | Combines parts \+ labor into the customer estimate; runs line-by-line approval; receives reassign notifications and chooses re-procure. |
| Customer | External | Approves/declines estimate lines; pays 100% advance for foreign parts. |
| Management | Governance | Approves Purchase Orders before issue. |
| Store Keeper | Parts | GRN against PO (alone), books stock, sets sell price, picks by rack, marks request-received/part-ready, dispositions returns. |
| Picker | Parts | Collects ready parts, captures sign/photo, sets WIP, transports to floor. |
| Receiver (Technician/SE) | Execution | Accepts part on floor with sign/photo; raises returns. |
| Job Controller (JC) | Execution | Assigns team/bay; the job card triggers delivery requisitions. |
| Accounts | Finance | Confirms foreign advance received; receives payment requests; nets advance at invoice. |
| Parts Manager / Admin | Governance | Reassigns reservations (with reason \+ audit); overrides with audit. |
| System | — | Auto-reserves on approval, auto-transitions states, notifies, blocks/unblocks jobs, locks prices. |

# **2\. Master Flow (Phases 1–8)**

One part's journey from diagnosis to invoice, with the returns branch. Each numbered phase expands into a sub-flow in §3–§6.

![][image1]

| Phase | Name | In | Out |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 1 | Trigger | SE diagnosis identifies replacement/refill | Parts requirement (description \+ media) routed to Parts |
| 2 | Identification & Estimation | Requirement without part number | Submitted estimate — lines identified, priced (LOCKED), optioned, availability-flagged |
| 3 | Customer Approval | Combined estimate (parts \+ labor) via SA | Per-line APPROVED / DECLINED; approved in-stock lines auto-reserved |
| 4 | Sourcing | Approved lines | In stock → RESERVED; out of stock → PO (foreign: after advance) → GRN → stock; job parts-blocked while waiting |
| 5 | Requisition & Fulfillment | JC job assignment | Part physically on floor via custody chain; state WIP → RECEIVED; partial allowed |
| 6 | In Use | Received part | Part in use on vehicle; inventory still WIP |
| 7 | Invoice | Job invoiced | WIP → CONSUMED; COGS recognized; advance netted |
| 8 | Returns (branch) | Bad/unneeded part on floor | Restockable → stock; defective → RTV \+ vendor claim; job re-blocked if part still needed |

# **3\. Sub-Flow 1 — Identification & Estimation**

![][image2]

## **3.1 Steps**

| \# | Actor | Action | System behaviour / state |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 1 | SE | At diagnosis, flags an item as replacement/refill against a concern/task; enters free-text description; attaches photo/video/audio (all optional) | EstimateLine created in REQUESTED; routed to Parts queue; notification to Parts |
| 2 | Parts Buyer | Searches catalog by description, keyword, fitment, alternate/vendor numbers; supersession surfaces current number | Search across part master incl. media and relationships |
| 3a | Parts Buyer | Match found → links Part Number to the line | Line → IDENTIFIED |
| 3b | Parts Buyer | No match → creates a new part record (Part Number assigned/captured) | New part in catalog (status Active); line → IDENTIFIED |
| 4 | Parts Buyer | Prices from the per-part vendor matrix; selects sourcing type; may attach MULTIPLE options on one line for the customer to choose | Line → PRICED/OPTIONED; sell price from part record |
| 5 | System | Availability check on each line | In stock → flag IN-STOCK. Not in stock but catalogued → REQUIRE quantity \+ estimated delivery date on the line. Foreign sourcing → flag 100% ADVANCE REQUIRED |
| 6 | Parts Buyer | Submits the parts estimate to the SA | Lines → SUBMITTED; PRICES LOCK (immutable from here) |
| 7 | System / SA | Combines parts lines \+ SE findings \+ labor into one customer estimate | Single customer-facing estimate document |
| 8 | Customer (via SA) | Reviews line by line; selects all or deselects any | Per line: APPROVED or DECLINED |
| 9 | System | On approval of an in-stock line | Soft reservation created (see §5); requisition entitlement granted — no further human approval needed downstream |
| 10 | System | If an approved part later becomes unavailable | Line → SUBSTITUTION REQUIRED; substitute offered as a NEW line → new customer approval. The original line's price is never edited |

**RULE:**  Price lock: after step 6 no field on a submitted line may change — not price, not option, not sourcing type. Unavailability creates a new line; it never reopens the old one.

# **4\. Sub-Flow 2 — Procurement (PO → GRN)**

![][image3]

## **4.1 Steps**

| \# | Actor | Action | System behaviour / state |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 1 | System | Triggers: approved line with no stock, or a part hits reorder level | Procurement task in Parts queue |
| 2 | System | If sourcing type \= FOREIGN: hard gate | PO creation BLOCKED in AWAITING ADVANCE until Accounts confirms customer's 100% advance received (recorded as deposit liability). No exception path |
| 3 | Parts Buyer | Comparative study on the vendor matrix (price, lead, rating, preferred, returns history) | Vendor selected |
| 4 | Parts Buyer | Creates PO: vendor, part lines, qty, unit price, discount, sourcing type, currency, and MANDATORY expected arrival date | PO → DRAFT → PENDING APPROVAL on submit |
| 5 | Management | Approves or rejects | Approve → ISSUED; Reject → REJECTED (buyer revises → back to DRAFT, or cancels) |
| 6 | System | On ISSUED | Dependent job(s)/task(s) → PARTS-BLOCKED; blocking part, vendor, expected arrival date visible on the job; SA/JC can see the date |
| 7 | Store Keeper | Goods arrive: GRN against the PO — verifies items, quantities, condition. Store keeper alone; no second checker | Full match → RECEIVED. Discrepancy → PARTIALLY RECEIVED: good lines booked, discrepancy flagged on the rest |
| 8 | Store Keeper | Books stock; sets/confirms SELL PRICE at logging | On-hand ↑; part cost recorded from PO; sell price stored on part record |
| 9 | System | Attaches waiting reservations; unblocks jobs | Reserved-waiting lines attach to the received stock; job → unblocked; SA/JC notified; requisition can proceed |
| 10 | System | Raises payment request to Accounts | PO ↔ GRN linked for matching; PO → CLOSED after payment request |

**RULE:**  Foreign gate is binary: advance CONFIRMED RECEIVED (not merely promised) before a PO can exist. Model the confirmation as an explicit Accounts action, not a checkbox on the PO.

# **5\. Sub-Flow 3 — Requisition, Reservation & Custody**

![][image4]

## **5.1 Reservation rules**

* At customer approval of an in-stock line, the system creates a SOFT RESERVATION: physical stock does not move; available-to-promise (ATP) \= on-hand − reserved.

* The part record displays the reserving job/vehicle. Estimator and JC views must show ATP, never raw on-hand.

* Reassign (rare): Parts Manager/Admin may move a reservation Job A → Job B. Requires a reason; writes an audit entry (who, when, from/to, why). If Job A is in progress or near completion, show a warning \+ explicit confirm.

* On reassign: Job A's line → NEEDS PART; Job A → PARTS-BLOCKED; Job A's SA is NOTIFIED with an action — SA chooses RE-PROCURE, which raises the PO flow (§4) for the replacement.

## **5.2 Steps**

| \# | Actor | Action | System behaviour / state |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 1 | JC | Assigns team \+ bay; issues work from the job card | Delivery requisition can now be raised |
| 2 | Tech/SE (or JC) | Raises requisition from the job's parts view: multi-select parts, QUANTITY per line, note (urgency) | Requisition → CREATED. Approval \= inherited from customer approval; auto-approved. → SENT TO STORE |
| 3 | Store Keeper | Sees requisition with each part's rack/bin; acknowledges | → REQUEST RECEIVED |
| 4 | Store Keeper | Picks physical parts. If some lines lack stock: PARTIAL — ready lines proceed; missing lines stay PENDING with reason (procure / substitute) | All lines → PART READY, or → PARTIALLY READY (per-line states) |
| 5 | System | Notifies the Picker | Pick task with location(s) |
| 6 | Picker | Collects part(s); captures digital signature AND/OR photo with the part | Line → PICKED/WIP; inventory: RESERVED → WIP; proof artifact stored on the custody record |
| 7 | Picker | Carries to the floor / bay | — |
| 8 | Receiver (Tech/SE) | Accepts the part; captures signature and/or photo | Line → RECEIVED; part shows IN USE on that vehicle; inventory still WIP |
| 9 | System | At invoice generation (job level) | All RECEIVED lines → CLOSED; inventory WIP → CONSUMED; COGS recognized; advance netted |

**RULE:**  Custody proof is per hand-off, not per requisition: pick proof and receive proof are separate artifacts with separate actors and timestamps. Whether signature, photo, or both are mandatory is a per-workspace configuration.

# **6\. Sub-Flow 4 — Returns & RTV**

![][image5]

## **6.1 Steps**

| \# | Actor | Action | System behaviour / state |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 1 | Tech/SE (floor) | Raises RETURN on a requisition line: reason code — DEFECTIVE / WRONG PART / NOT USED / EXCESS — plus photo; signs/photographs the hand-back | Return record opened; reverse custody begins |
| 2 | Picker / Store | Receives the part back; signs/photographs | Custody → Parts; part physically at store |
| 3 | Store Keeper | Inspects and DISPOSITIONS | RESTOCKABLE → inventory WIP reversed → AVAILABLE (ATP restored). DEFECTIVE → QUARANTINE/RTV (excluded from sellable stock) |
| 4 | System | On DEFECTIVE | Vendor claim opened against the ORIGINAL PO (replacement or credit); defect recorded against vendor → QUALITY RATING reduced |
| 5 | System | If the job still needs the part | Job line → re-opened; job → PARTS-BLOCKED; SA/JC notified; resolution \= re-pick (stock) or re-procure (PO flow §4) |
| 6 | System | If not needed | Line closed; return record closed |

**RULE:**  Returns occur BEFORE invoice in this flow (WIP reversal). A post-invoice return is a billing correction (credit note) in the Accounts module, out of scope for this flow.

# **7\. State Machines & Transition Tables**

Authoritative state enums. Any transition not listed is INVALID and must be rejected by the system. “Actor” \= who/what may trigger.

## **7.1 Estimate Line**

![][image6]

| From | To | Trigger / Actor |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| REQUESTED | IDENTIFIED | Parts buyer links or creates Part Number |
| IDENTIFIED | PRICED/OPTIONED | Parts buyer prices from vendor matrix (+qty & est. delivery date if not in stock) |
| PRICED/OPTIONED | SUBMITTED 🔒 | Parts buyer submits to SA — PRICE LOCKS |
| SUBMITTED | APPROVED | Customer approves the line (via SA) |
| SUBMITTED | DECLINED | Customer declines the line |
| APPROVED | FULFILLED | Requisition flow completes; consumed at invoice |
| APPROVED | SUBSTITUTION REQUIRED | System: part becomes unavailable (never a price edit) |
| SUBSTITUTION REQUIRED | → new line at REQUESTED | System raises substitute as a NEW line; new approval cycle |

## **7.2 Purchase Order**

![][image7]

| From | To | Trigger / Actor |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| AWAITING ADVANCE (foreign only) | DRAFT | Accounts confirms 100% customer advance received |
| DRAFT | PENDING APPROVAL | Buyer submits (expected arrival date mandatory) |
| PENDING APPROVAL | ISSUED | Management approves → dependent jobs PARTS-BLOCKED |
| PENDING APPROVAL | REJECTED | Management rejects |
| REJECTED | DRAFT | Buyer revises |
| ISSUED | IN TRANSIT | Vendor ships / buyer marks |
| IN TRANSIT | RECEIVED | Store keeper GRN, full match → stock booked, sell price set |
| IN TRANSIT | PARTIALLY RECEIVED | Store keeper GRN with discrepancy — good lines booked, rest flagged |
| PARTIALLY RECEIVED | RECEIVED | Balance received / discrepancy resolved |
| RECEIVED | CLOSED | System raises payment request to Accounts (PO↔GRN linked) |
| DRAFT / PENDING APPROVAL | CANCELLED | Buyer or management |

## **7.3 Part Stock Unit**

![][image8]

| From | To | Trigger / Actor |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| PENDING PROCUREMENT | AVAILABLE | GRN books stock (store keeper) |
| AVAILABLE | RESERVED | System: customer approves in-stock line (soft reserve; ATP ↓) |
| RESERVED | AVAILABLE | System: reassigned away or line cancelled (ATP restored) |
| RESERVED | WIP | Picker collects with sign/photo |
| WIP | CONSUMED | System: invoice generated (COGS recognized) |
| WIP | RETURNED-RESTOCKABLE | Return dispositioned restockable (store keeper) |
| WIP | RETURNED-DEFECTIVE | Return dispositioned defective (store keeper) |
| RETURNED-RESTOCKABLE | AVAILABLE | Store keeper restocks (WIP reversed) |
| RETURNED-DEFECTIVE | VENDOR CLAIM (RTV) | System opens claim vs original PO; vendor rating reduced |

## **7.4 Requisition**

![][image9]

| From | To | Trigger / Actor |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| CREATED (auto-approved) | SENT TO STORE | System, immediately on creation |
| SENT TO STORE | REQUEST RECEIVED | Store keeper acknowledges |
| REQUEST RECEIVED | PART READY | Store keeper picks — all lines available |
| REQUEST RECEIVED | PARTIALLY READY | Store keeper picks — some lines missing (per-line pending with reason) |
| PARTIALLY READY | PART READY | Missing lines resolved (re-stock / substitute / procure) |
| PART READY | PICKED / WIP | Picker collects with sign/photo |
| PICKED / WIP | RECEIVED | Floor receiver accepts with sign/photo |
| RECEIVED | CLOSED | System: invoice generated |
| RECEIVED | RETURN RAISED | Floor raises a return (§6) |
| CREATED / SENT TO STORE | CANCELLED | Authorized role, with reason |

# **8\. Notification Map**

Minimum notification set. All are in-app \+ email per the platform's notification engine; each carries contextual tags (vehicle, job, part, requester, reason).

| Event | Notify | Content / action |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| SE raises parts requirement | Parts queue | New identification/estimation task |
| Estimate submitted | SA | Parts estimate ready to combine and present |
| Line approved (in stock) | Parts / Store | Reservation created; upcoming requisition |
| Line approved (procure) | Parts Buyer | Procurement task (foreign: shows awaiting-advance) |
| Advance confirmed (foreign) | Parts Buyer | Gate open — PO can be created |
| PO pending approval | Management | Approve / reject action |
| PO issued | SA \+ JC of dependent jobs | Job parts-blocked; expected arrival date |
| GRN booked | SA \+ JC of waiting jobs; Buyer | Job unblocked; stock available; payment request raised |
| Requisition sent | Store Keeper | Pick task with rack locations |
| Part ready | Picker | Collection task |
| Picked (WIP) | Floor receiver | Incoming part |
| Received on floor | JC (visibility) | Part with team, in use |
| Partial fulfillment | Requester \+ SA/JC | Which lines pending and why |
| Reservation reassigned | Job A's SA (ACTION) | Must choose: RE-PROCURE (raises PO flow). Job A parts-blocked |
| Return dispositioned defective | Buyer \+ Vendor record | RTV claim opened; rating updated |
| Job re-blocked after return | SA \+ JC | Re-pick or re-procure decision |

# **9\. Suggested Build Order**

Dependency-ordered so each increment is testable on its own.

* 1 — Part catalog & inventory master (entities, search, stock quantities incl. ATP derivation). Everything keys off this.

* 2 — Vendor master \+ per-part vendor matrix (needed by estimation and procurement).

* 3 — Estimation flow (§3) with price-lock and line states; SA combination \+ line-by-line approval; auto-reservation.

* 4 — Procurement (§4): PO lifecycle, management approval, foreign advance gate (stub the Accounts confirmation), GRN \+ partial receive, sell-price-at-logging, parts-blocked propagation.

* 5 — Requisition & custody (§5): auto-approved requisitions, store/picker/receiver states, proof capture, partial fulfillment, WIP.

* 6 — Reassign branch \+ notification map (§8).

* 7 — Returns & RTV (§6): reverse custody, disposition, vendor-rating feedback, job re-blocking.

* 8 — Invoice hook: WIP → CONSUMED on invoice generation (integration point with Billing/Accounts).

Cross-reference: functional requirements live in the Parts Division SOW \+ SRS (FR-PRT-CAT/EST/PROC/VEN/REQ/INV/RET/ACC). Where this flow document and the SOW differ on sequence or state, this document governs for implementation; raise the conflict for a formal SOW revision.
